Introducing Debrief!
Every race has a story. Now it’s your turn to tell it. Review every race, share your thoughts, and discover what the community thinks.

Also in this update:
→ A fresh new Dashboard experience
→ Lights Out is here—put your reaction time to the test
→ Better localization throughout the app
→ Performance improvements worthy of a qualifying lap
→ Lots of bug fixes behind the scenes

Got feedback or ideas? We’d love to hear from you at reachus@boxbox.club.
results.description:
Join over 4 million Formula 1 fans with Box Box Club, the ultimate F1 companion app for live race updates, Formula 1 widgets, race schedules, driver stats, championship standings, race ratings, reviews, and breaking motorsport news.

Follow every Formula 1, Formula 2, Formula 3, and F1 Academy race with beautifully designed Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Apple Watch widgets, personalised notifications, live timing, in-depth statistics, and community race ratings that let you see how fans scored every Grand Prix.

Features

• Live F1 race updates and session tracking
•  Rate and review every race weekend
• Personalised widgets and race notifications
• Race weekend schedule with countdowns in your local time
• Live Driver Championship (WDC) and Constructor Championship (WCC) standings
• Compare drivers with Head-to-Head season and career statistics
• Detailed driver, team, and circuit statistics
• Breaking Formula 1 news, guides, glossary, and facts
• Support for Formula 1, Formula 2, Formula 3, and F1 Academy

Widgets

Customise your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Apple Watch with widgets for:

• Live race updates and standings
• Race schedule and countdown
• Driver Championship standings
• Constructor Championship standings
• Favourite driver and team
• Driver photos and team badges

Available in Small, Medium, and Large widget sizes.

Supports Light, Dark, Clear, and Tinted widget styles on iPhone and iPad.

Download Box Box today and never miss another Formula 1 race.

For details on our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use, please visit:

- https://boxbox.club/Privacy.html
- https://boxbox.club/Terms.html
